stories.title: Five Points district to receive $200,000 funding infusion for security and beautification
stories.summary: The money will help kickstart improvements in the area following the creation of the Five Points business improvement district.

stories.title: Duval County growers claim victory with passage of Pathways to Urban Agriculture Act
stories.summary: Jacksonville growers attended city council meetings for months, advocating for rules that will make it easier to operate community gardens and sell their products.

stories.title: Statue of Civil Rights leader unveiled in St. Augustine
stories.summary: Dr. Robert Hayling led St. Augustine's Civil Rights movement, was attacked by the KKK, and endured to share civil rights history with later generations.

stories.title: 'Couldn't be prouder': Oakleaf student takes the stage in rehearsals for Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: Fifteen-year-old Brendan Bowens from Oakleaf High School will perform in the historic 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. His mom shares what it took to get here.

stories.title: New restaurant and bar coming to Jacksonville’s Riverfront Plaza in 2028
stories.summary: A new restaurant and bar is expected to open in 2028 at Riverfront Plaza, giving visitors a place to grab lunch.

stories.title: Jacksonville fugitive arrested in Connecticut, wanted for armed burglary
stories.summary: The U.S. Marshal Service says that the man was wanted for an armed burglary at a home on the First Coast in early November.

stories.title: Riverside Arts Market anticipates major funding loss as Jacksonville cuts cultural grants budget
stories.summary: Organizers say the weekly market will lose $80,000 next year due to city grant budget cuts tied to the passage of Amendment 3.

stories.title: 'Not good at all': Hilliard residents say years of road paving promises remain unkept
stories.summary: People living along Pratt Siding Rd. and Wedgewood Way say they have been asking for the roads to be paved for years.

stories.title: Orange Park Mall gets new management as new businesses open and more planned
stories.summary: Orange Park Mall is entering the holiday season with new management, new businesses and more openings planned, with more changes expected to take shape in 2027.

stories.title: 3 adults, 1 teen from Jacksonville arrested in attempted Palm City home invasion
stories.summary: The Martin County Sheriff's Office says that the four had parked by a nearby canal before attempting to break into the home.

stories.title: Jacksonville pharmacy tech sentenced in stolen prescription pill scheme as 3 men face charges
stories.summary: Jasmine Bello, 21, has been sentenced to seven years in prison for stealing hundreds of oxycodone and hydrocodone pills from a Walgreens pharmacy where she worked.

stories.title: Two men arrested in connection with an early-morning SWAT operation in St. Augustine
stories.summary: St. Augustine police said the operation was preplanned and there is no threat to the community.
